title: Odile and the Kitchen
author: A. M. Whitlock
blurb: Juniper Okonkwo, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
